title: Follow up on an existing support case

summary.text: To open an existing case, you need its case number and the verified email address for the case. The portal emails a fresh access code to that address.

problem.text: A user has a support case and wants to open it again.

symptoms.text: The user has a case number and wants to continue the conversation.

user_phrases.text: How do I check my support case?
How do I reopen my case?

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

resolutions.action: Open the support portal at https://daedalus.support.se7enlabs.com and choose Open an existing case.
Enter your case number and the verified email address for the case.
Enter the code from the email in the Six-digit access code field.
resolutions.why: After Send access code, the page asks for the code that was emailed to the verified address.
Open case checks the code and opens the case.

expected_outcome.text: The case opens in the support portal.

evidence.rationale: Release notes, tagged source and portal pages directly state the behavior; this is source inspection, not runtime testing.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
